description: Bounded Quick Workflow smoke check (plugin-lifecycle-upstream Phase 7) — confirms the skill's own documented trigger/non-trigger examples hold and its core Step 2-4 procedure is followed.

uncovered: Plugin removed from marketplace.json — table row removal
Broken .claude/rules/*.md reference caught by human-doc-reviewer's Step 3
testing_validation_coverage.note: This is a bounded Phase 7 smoke check, not a full eval suite. eval-1 exercises scenario 1 (plugin added) and eval-3 exercises scenario 3 (no changes needed, clean no-op) of the SKILL.md's own numbered 'Scenarios'. eval-2 tests a different, valuable dimension (the trigger/non-trigger boundary against plugin-documentation) that isn't one of the 4 numbered scenarios, so it doesn't count toward this coverage field even though it's a real, passing eval. The 2 remaining uncovered scenarios are lower-risk (a symmetric table-removal case, or delegated to human-doc-reviewer's own already-tested logic) and are not re-verified here. This satisfies R28's min_eval_scenarios=3 (evals: 3).

evals.name: Plugin added to marketplace.json — activates and follows procedure
evals.prompt: Using the marketplace-documentation skill, treat evals/marketplace-documentation/fixture-eval1/marketplace.json as the marketplace manifest and evals/marketplace-documentation/fixture-eval1/README.md as the README to update for this run (a fixture pair, not the real repo-root files). A new plugin `example-kit` was just added to that manifest — it's already present in the fixture manifest with a real description but missing from the fixture README's Plugins table. Update the fixture README's plugin table to reflect this.
evals.expected_output: Reads the fixture marketplace.json as source of truth; adds a real new table row for example-kit to the fixture README using its actual fixture description (not a placeholder); never writes to the fixture marketplace.json itself; invokes human-doc-reviewer afterward (mentions it explicitly, does not skip it).

evals.name: Non-trigger — a single plugin's own README
evals.prompt: Write docs for the git-kit plugin — update its own README.md with its current skill list.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as plugin-documentation's job (a single plugin's own docs), not marketplace-documentation's — does not attempt to read/regenerate the marketplace-root README's plugin table for this request.

evals.name: No changes needed — table already matches marketplace.json — clean no-op reporting
evals.prompt: Check whether the marketplace README's plugin table matches .claude-plugin/marketplace.json's current plugin list, and update it if it doesn't.
evals.expected_output: Reads .claude-plugin/marketplace.json as source of truth, compares it against README's actual current plugin table, finds no discrepancy, and reports that no changes are needed rather than fabricating an edit or silently making a no-op change look like real work.
